sourceDescription: Selected logistic-regression FedAvg configuration evaluated on the development pool.
scope: Five-seed development reconstruction configuration. This file does not contain fitted arrays and does not establish that test predictions can be regenerated.

algorithm.model: Multinomial logistic regression (697 inputs, nine class outputs; 6,282 float64 parameters).
algorithm.objective: Inverse-frequency-weighted softmax cross-entropy plus L2 on weights only; lambda is zero, so no regularization term contributes.
algorithm.initialization: Xavier/Glorot-uniform weights from NumPy default_rng(seed); zero biases.
algorithm.localOptimization: At each round, every client starts from the current global parameters and runs five full-batch gradient-descent steps on its local development rows at learning rate 0.3.
algorithm.serverAggregation: Weighted parameter mean using client row count n_k / sum(n_k); each client has 80 development windows, so each weight is 1/8.
algorithm.ensemble: Average the nine-class probabilities from the five seed-specific models before taking the maximum-probability class.
algorithm.selectionContext: The setting was chosen using development data after exploratory-cohort results were known; no test cases were used to build the development models.

note: The selected arrays, signatures, and test predictions are intentionally not distributed in this package.
